rationale: The plan correctly identifies this as an interaction question and fits ~genotype+treatment+genotype:treatment, extracting the interaction coefficient plus two named simple-effect contrasts with explicit reference levels — exactly matching the reference. QC (vst blind PCA, distance heatmap, library size, outlier policy) precedes the model, and normalization is handled entirely inside DESeq2 size factors with no pre-normalized input. The filter (>=10 counts in >=4 samples, tied to smallest cell size) is minimal and justified; BH-FDR at 0.05 with ashr shrinkage on all three contrasts is correctly specified and independent filtering is used properly (thresholds in-test, not post hoc). Enrichment is well justified with stated ranking metric (Wald stat), named collections/versions, size windows, and per-contrast separation, though 'apeglm' listed in packages despite the text disavowing its use for contrasts is a minor inconsistency. The final report is comprehensive, naming versions, design, thresholds, gene counts, and explicitly flags the n=4/cell power caveat for the interaction test.
